limitations: Recovery counts resolved surface forms, not admitted supervision. Each recovered concept still faces the downstream extraction gates that R12 and R12B measured and could not quantify.
No coffee group count is claimed. Group formation was not run.
Fragments resolving only through a BROAD_CATEGORY_ONLY rule remain broad and are not promoted to specific descriptors.
Unresolved fragments remain queued under existing policy; none were admitted.
